en.headline: Wear’s HK designer pop-ups run through 14 September
en.dek: Twenty Hong Kong fashion labels are showing at six malls and the airport until 14 September, part of the government-backed Hong Kong Fashion Fest.
body: Wear’s HK, a citywide pop-up programme under the third Hong Kong Fashion Fest, continues at six sites until 14 September. The Clothing Industry Training Authority is organising the project with sponsorship from the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency under the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau.

The official programme lists Harbour City, ifc mall, Harvey Nichols at Pacific Place, Hong Kong International Airport, Hysan Place and Festival Walk as the six locations, presenting work by 20 Hong Kong fashion designers. A related display of the same designers’ clothes is also running until 14 September at the Common Arcade on the first floor of Jardine House in Central, as part of Fashion Summit (HK) 2026.

The government said the two-week Fashion Fest, which opened on 1 September, gathers more than 300 local and overseas design units across eight flagship programmes. It said public exhibitions under the festival are free.

zh.headline: 時裝薇Wear’s HK快閃店開至本月十四日
zh.dek: 第三屆香港時裝薇的全城快閃店「Wear’s HK」在六個商場及機場展出20個本地時裝品牌，活動持續至9月14日。
body: 第三屆香港時裝薇旗下的全城快閃店項目「Wear’s HK」現正舉行，至9月14日結束。項目由製衣業訓練局主辦，文化體育及旅遊局轄下文創產業發展處贊助。
主辦單位公布的六個地點分別為海港城、國際金融中心商場、太古廣場Harvey Nichols、香港國際機場、希慎廣場及又一城，展出20個香港時裝設計師品牌。同一批設計師的作品亦在中環怡和大廈一樓公共走廊展出，作為「時尚高峰（香港）2026」展覽一部分，同樣至14日。
政府早前表示，為期兩周的時裝薇由9月1日開始，匯聚超過300個本地與海外設計單位，並設八個旗艦節目。時裝薇公眾展覽免費入場。
